author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Turns out that  Samsung sells a CRAZY inexpensive smartphone called the A06. And its time to see if this A Series Smartphone can survive a durability test.  Get your own Smartphone tool kit here: https://www.ifixit.com/JerryRig Samsung is very well known for their premium smartphones.  Which means these more budget A-Series devices fly under the radar.  But not today! Today we are going to be durability testing the Samsung A06 to see if it can survive a JerryRigEverything durability test. 

Then we will take apart the Samsung A06 to see if it can be repaired. 

Current pricing of the Samsung A06 is here: https://amzn.to/4uhbiBZ
title: Samsung's $95 Dollar smartphone is crazy
